lines: Good evening. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries said Democrats should focus on lowering costs instead of getting even, but critics say accountability and delivering results go hand in hand, Fox News reports.

The Conservation Officer Service in British Columbia says more than one grizzly may have been involved in a bear attack that relatives say left a mother and daughter dead in Bella Coola along the province’s central coast, The Canadian Press reports.
Ukraine says bodycam video shows deadly Russian double-tap bombing, BBC News reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
